subject: Launch trajectory agreement and owners
messages:
From: Lina Perez <lina.perez@novaanalytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@novaanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:02:14 -0700
Subject: Launch trajectory agreement and owners

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We walked the team through the Redwood inference performance numbers and they were impressed. Before our Execs greenlight the pilot, Procurement and the product owners asked for a concrete launch trajectory and clarity on who owns each milestone.

Can you put together a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with target milestone dates, acceptance criteria, and named owners (Redwood and Nova)? Procurement also wants to see a draft SOW to align on deliverables and a short list of required compliance artifacts (SOC2 / data handling).

High level goals from our side:
- Pilot ready (internal QA + 1 public endpoint) in ~8 weeks
- Data ingress validated (S3 + streaming)
- SSO and baseline audit trail in place for the pilot

I've looped Tom (Engineering lead) for availability. Procurement will follow up separately but would like the SOW preview this week.

Thanks —
Lina Perez
Director, AI Integrations
Nova Analytics

--
Attachment: none in this message
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Perez <lina.perez@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@novaanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:18:52 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch trajectory agreement and owners

Lina — really appreciate the clear asks. I've drafted a compact MAP and a preliminary SOW to accelerate Procurement. Attaching both files to this thread (MAP-draft.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf).

Quick summary of what you'll find in the MAP:
- Three-phase trajectory (Prepare -> Pilot -> Expansion) with milestone dates and named owners
- Acceptance criteria per milestone (tech and business checkpoints)
- Contingency triggers (capacity, security sign-off) and fallback model variants

Proposed 8-week pilot timeline (high level):
1) Week 0-2: Kickoff, environment provisioning, SSO connectivity (Owner: Jonas Weber / Redwood; Nova owner: Tom Hughes)
2) Week 3-5: Data ingest and validation, sample inference testing (Owner: Naomi Feldman / Redwood; Nova owner: Lina Perez)
3) Week 6-8: Pilot cutover, acceptance testing, and knowledge transfer (Owner: Marissa Cole / Redwood; Nova owner: Product Ops lead TBD)

Open items I flagged in the MAP: procurement terms for reserved capacity, required SOC2 artifact list, and SSO attribute mapping (we included a short checklist).

Can the team review the MAP and SOW and reply with any date or owner conflicts by EOD Wednesday? If that works, we'll lock dates and generate a versioned SOW for Procurement.

Attachments:
- MAP-draft.xlsx (compact milestone grid)
- SOW-draft.pdf (deliverables overview, assumptions, rough pricing)

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Perez <lina.perez@novaanalytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@novaanalytics.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch trajectory agreement and owners

Team — I reviewed Karthik's MAP and expanded the milestone grid into a short operational playbook. Below is a practical 8-week run with specific owners and acceptance criteria. I've kept dates conservative to allow Procurement review.

Operational 8-week plan (dates are target windows)
- Week 0 (Jun 28 - Jul 4): Kickoff + access
  - Redwood owner: Jonas Weber (Solution Architect)
  - Nova owner: Tom Hughes (Eng Lead)
  - Acceptance: VPC peering / network allowlist complete; access to sample S3 bucket; kickoff slide deck signed

- Week 1-2 (Jul 5 - Jul 18): Provisioning + SSO
  - Redwood owner: Jonas Weber
  - Nova owner: Identity Ops (TBD)
  - Acceptance: SSO test user can auth; IdP metadata exchanged; attribute map agreed

- Week 3-4 (Jul 19 - Aug 1): Data ingress + validation
  - Redwood owner: Naomi Feldman (Platform PM)
  - Nova owner: Lina Perez (Data Integrations)
  - Acceptance: Ingest pipeline processes 10k sample records; inference latency within agreed SLO; tokenization and schema validated

- Week 5-6 (Aug 2 - Aug 15): Pilot run + monitoring
  - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (Implementation Lead)
  - Nova owner: Product Ops (TBD)
  - Acceptance: Live pilot traffic for 72 hours; logging/traceability verified; cost dashboard enabled

- Week 7-8 (Aug 16 - Aug 29): Acceptance + knowledge transfer
  - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole
  - Nova owner: Product Ops / Ops Manager
  - Acceptance: Sign-off on pilot metrics document; handoff to CS with runbook and playbook; go/no-go decision recorded

Key notes and dependencies:
- Procurement: we'll provide a versioned SOW for review by Jun 25 to keep timelines intact. Procurement lead should confirm billing/contact details.
- Compliance: we'll attach the SOC2 summary and retention policy; Nova should confirm any extra audit requirements.
- SSO: Jonas will send a short attribute mapping template.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Karthik: confirm procurement contact and any billing constraints (due Wed, Jun 23)
- Lina: identify Product Ops lead for acceptance and handoff (due Wed, Jun 23)
- Jonas: share IdP attribute map template (due Tue, Jun 22)
- Naomi: prepare ingest validation checklist (due Fri, Jun 25)

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these owners and target windows; if no objections by EOD Wednesday we'll lock and export a clean SOW for procurement.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--

Subject: Re: Launch trajectory agreement and owners

Marissa / Karthik — this looks great and much more actionable. A couple of small edits from our side:
1) We need the pilot window to end by Aug 22 instead of Aug 29 (internal launch commitment). Can you tighten week 7-8 acceptance window to Aug 9 - Aug 22 and confirm owners still able to hit that?
2) I'll attach a short SSO requirements doc for your IdP team (nova-sso-requirements.docx).
3) Procurement asked that you mark the SOW as "Draft - For Review" and include a 30-day negotiation window.

If you can produce the updated MAP and mark the SOW as requested, Procurement will begin an initial review tomorrow. Once Procurement confirms, we'll circulate Product Ops contact details.

Accepting the MAP with the August 22 go-live target pending your confirmation on date compression.

Best,
Lina Perez
Director, AI Integrations | Nova Analytics
